display.purpose: Constellation names and page titles only. Never UI chrome.

body.purpose: All Korean UI text. word-break: keep-all.

label.purpose: Course codes and numerals ONLY. No Korean glyphs exist in this font.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrance/state pops (sprout, celebratePop). Elastic easings were removed.

motion.name: edge-glow
motion.purpose: Lit constellation edges. Opacity only - never transform on SVG lines (real bug).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation/transition durations forced to ~0; onAnimationEnd routing still fires.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action color (spec-b) on dark ink; hover dims slightly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--spec-b, #9DB4FF); color: var(--ink-900, #04060B); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans KR', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spec-b, #9DB4FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered secondary action; hover raises to ink-700.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-hi, #E8EAF2); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans KR', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2A3350); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ink-700, #1C2338); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spec-b, #9DB4FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Dark well input with rule hairline; spec-b caret and focus outline.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgb(4 6 11 / 0.6); color: var(--text-hi, #E8EAF2); caret-color: var(--spec-b, #9DB4FF); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans KR', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2A3350); border-radius: 12px; width: 240px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-lo, #8891AC); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spec-b, #9DB4FF); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Floating Panel
components.description: Overlay panel material: translucent ink-800 + backdrop blur over the fullscreen canvas.
components.html: 패널은 캔버스 위에 떠 있는 오버레이다.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgb(19 24 41 / 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2A3350); border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px; width: 260px; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgb(0 0 0 / .38); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans KR', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: rgb(4 6 11 / 0.6); padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-lo, #8891AC); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s, background-color .15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-hi, #E8EAF2); } .ds-tab-on { background: var(--ink-700, #1C2338); color: var(--text-hi, #E8EAF2); } .ds-panel-body { color: var(--text-lo, #8891AC); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 10px 4px 2px; word-break: keep-all; }

components.name: Element Chip
components.description: Bin item chip: spectral-type color dot + label; mono is reserved for course codes.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgb(28 35 56 / 0.5); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2A3350); border-radius: 16px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans KR', sans-serif; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--spec-b, #9DB4FF); } .ds-chip-code { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-lo, #8891AC); letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-chip-label { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-hi, #E8EAF2); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--ink-700, #1C2338); }

components.name: Landing CTA (paper world)
components.description: Bright star-chart landing only: ink-filled CTA; hover presses the ink darker, active nudges down 1px.
components.css: .ds-cta-ink { background: var(--paper-ink, #10141F); color: var(--paper, #F6F7FA); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans KR', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease-out; } .ds-cta-ink:hover { background: #05070d; } .ds-cta-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-cta-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--paper-ink, #10141F); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Printed star chart and the observation sky (jong-i seongdo / gwancheuk uju)
narrative.overview: One system, two worlds. The logged-out landing is a bright paper star chart printed in blue-violet ink (--paper-*, .bg-paper-grid); every logged-in surface is a near-black observation sky (--ink-*, .bg-radec-grid). Both share the same blue-violet hue; the bridge is the one-shot aperture (light-to-dark) transition. The student is a cartographer, not a game player: decoration is limited to coordinate grids, hairline frames, tick marks, and line-art SVG. Functional absolute rules (SVG fill=transparent, no ambient background animation, panels are overlays) are owned by docs/design-handoff-guide.md; that document wins on conflict.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only app with exactly one bright exception: the landing
Astronomical vocabulary as token names (spectral classes spec-b/a/g/k/m, lit, RA/Dec grid)
Motion only at meaningful moments; no ambient background animation
Decoration via 1px hairlines and 3-4.5% opacity coordinate grids

rules.name: The Two-File Sync Rule
rules.body: Color values are duplicated in app/globals.css (CSS vars) and tailwind.config.ts (hex). Always change both; see docs/design-handoff-guide.md section 1.

rules.name: The Landing-Scope Rule
rules.body: --paper-* tokens and their focus/scrollbar/CTA rules live only inside the .telescope-landing scope and must not leak into app surfaces.

rules.name: The No-Korean-Mono Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono has no Korean glyphs. font-mono is for course codes and numerals only.

rules.name: The Starlight-Only Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow appears only for starlight (lit) moments; no ambient glow decoration on dark ground.

dos: Do change colors in both globals.css and tailwind.config.ts together.
Do import type-to-color mapping only from lib/element-colors.ts.
Do keep the spec-b focus ring (paper-ink on the landing) on every new interactive element.
Do keep decorative layers pointer-events: none and behind the graph.
donts: Don't use font-mono for Korean text - the glyphs don't exist.
Don't add ambient background animation (sole exception: pan-triggered drift).
Don't use mascots, illustration, game-like decoration, or gradient text.
Don't use --paper-* tokens on logged-in app surfaces.
Don't make lit edges green - starlight is warm yellow.
Don't use fill="none" for transparent SVG fills (docs/design-handoff-guide.md 3-1).
